Chocolate Sorbet
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:51pm

Ingredients




1 cup cocoa
cup sugar
cup water
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Preparation

1 Combine all but vanilla in a saucepan. Heat on medium, stirring frequently, until the mixture reaches a boil. Turn off heat, and stir in vanilla. Chill. Freeze according to your ice cream maker's instructions.
